content.short: Capa automates real-time pay-ins and pay-outs across Latin America with same-day settlement.
content.description: Capa handles pay-ins and pay-outs across Latin America and internationally, offering same-day settlement through a dashboard or API. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Businesses operating across several Latin American countries otherwise face a separate banking integration per market, which is the friction these providers exist to absorb.
